evals.prompt: /setup-issue-tracker 이 GitHub 저장소에서 spec 폴더를 GitHub Issues로 조정하게 설정해줘. gh 로그인은 되어 있고 AGENTS.md가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response proposes one compact AGENTS.md convention that links each spec folder to its issue through an `Issue: github:#<n>` line and seven ID-addressed operations, with no title key, managed-issue listing, or spec label, and without creating issues during setup.
expectations: It records the issue ID form as `github:#<number>` carried by an `Issue:` line in spec.md and in PR bodies.
It does not propose a `spec:<slug>` title key, a title prefix, a spec label, or a List managed issues operation.
It includes find, create, refresh the spec section, full blocker-set replacement, claim, mark ready, and close operations, each addressing an issue by its number.
Create uses the spec title, a bounded spec section as the body, and the recorded review signal, and returns the new number.
It records the exact markers that bound the spec section, matching the triage body renderer's `<!-- triage-issues:spec:start -->` and `<!-- triage-issues:spec:end -->` by default.
Its GitHub blocker update paginates every open and closed current relation before removing stale edges and adding missing ones, while Find still returns only open blockers for implementation gating.
It shows the proposed section before writing and does not create issues for existing spec folders during setup.

evals.prompt: /setup-issue-tracker 기존 AGENTS.md의 GitHub Issues 설정을 점검해줘. tracker와 gh tool은 그대로 두고 싶어. 지금은 `spec:<slug>` 제목 키, `Source-Issue` 줄, List managed issues 동작을 쓰고 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves the existing tracker identity and tool while replacing the title key, `Source-Issue` line, and managed-issue listing with the `Issue:` line and ID-addressed operations, and tells the user to rename active spec lines themselves.
expectations: It identifies the title key, `Source-Issue` line, and managed-issue listing as an outdated convention.
It preserves the existing tracker, tool, states, claim, and close behavior.
It replaces the key with the `Issue:` line and drops the listing operation instead of upgrading it.
It adds the mark-ready operation to the core operations and upgrades additive blocker edits to remove stale edges as well as add missing ones.
It tells the user to rename `Source-Issue:` to `Issue:` in active spec folders and leaves existing title-key issues for the user to tidy.
It does not create a second instruction file or create any issues.

evals.prompt: /setup-issue-tracker Linear 팀 DLY로 설정해줘. Linear MCP가 연결돼 있고 AGENTS.md가 있어. 일반 이슈 triage도 켤 거야.
evals.expected_output: The convention drafted for docs/issue-tracker.md includes the Due date, Check issue, and Notifications items under those exact names, the not-yet-judged query returns due dates and leaves out issues whose date is ahead, and setup asks once, optionally, about notifications.
expectations: It records a `Due date` item using Linear's native due-date field.

It records a `Check issue` item with a title form, an initial state the not-yet-judged query returns, an assignee rule, and a body bounded by `<!-- triage-issues:check:start -->` and `<!-- triage-issues:check:end -->` with a `Spec-Folder:` line, due date, merged PR, and the spec section copied as written.
The Check issue item includes a lookup that finds an existing check issue for one spec folder in any state by its Spec-Folder line.
It asks once whether the user wants notifications, as an optional step, and records `Notifications: None` when they decline.
The not-yet-judged query returns each issue's due date, leaves out issues whose date is still ahead, and orders due issues before undated ones.

evals.prompt: /setup-issue-tracker 기존 GitHub Issues 규약을 다시 점검해줘. 지금 docs/issue-tracker.md에는 Due date, Check issue, Notifications 항목이 없어. 알림은 필요 없어.
evals.expected_output: Setup preserves the existing convention, offers to add Due date and Check issue, and writes Notifications: None without further notification questions.
expectations: It preserves the existing tracker, tool, states, and operations.
It proposes a `Due date` item using a `Due: <YYYY-MM-DD>` body line because GitHub Issues has no due-date field.
It proposes a `Check issue` item with the bounded check section and a duplicate lookup by Spec-Folder line.
It writes `Notifications: None` and asks no further questions about notifications.
